title: Milo Balances Laundry Tower
story: Milo the orange cat in his green sweater tries to carry a huge tower of colorful laundry all at once. Pip the tiny mouse in the red cap climbs to the top to balance it. The tower starts wobbling left and right through the laundry room, bubbles floating everywhere. Milo walks super carefully while Pip shouts directions. Will they make it or will it all crash? Watch till the end! Follow for the next episode!

title: Milo Makes Giant Pizza Disaster
story: Milo and Pip decide to make the biggest pizza ever in their tiny kitchen. Milo tosses the dough and it flies up and sticks to the ceiling. Pip tries to pull it down but gets covered in tomato sauce and cheese. The kitchen is a total mess with flour everywhere. They slip and slide and the pizza lands upside down. Can they save dinner? Comment what you think happens next!

title: Milo Washes Car Bubble Chaos
story: Milo tries to wash the family car on a sunny day and uses way too much soap. In seconds the whole driveway is filled with a million giant bubbles. Pip the mouse jumps inside a bucket and starts surfing on the bubbles like a boat. Milo slips on the soapy water and slides across the driveway. The car is now covered in more bubbles than before. Will they ever get it clean?

title: Milo Builds IKEA Shelf Fail
story: Milo buys a new shelf from IKEA and thinks it will be easy. He opens the box and there are a hundred pieces and confusing instructions. Pip tries to help and gets trapped inside the box with all the screws and tiny tools. Milo puts the shelf together backwards and it wobbles and falls over. Pip pops out of the box holding the missing piece. Will they finally build it right? Follow for part two!

title: Milo Does Dishes Splash Zone
story: It is Milo's turn to do the dishes and he turns on the water way too high. Water splashes everywhere in the kitchen and Pip gets soaked. Pip grabs a dinner plate and starts riding it like a surfboard across the soapy counter. Milo tries to catch him and slips, making an even bigger splash zone. The kitchen floor is now a swimming pool. How will they dry it all up?

title: Milo Gardening Mayhem
story: Milo wants to plant beautiful flowers in the garden. He digs one small hole but Pip gets excited and starts digging holes everywhere super fast. Soon the whole garden looks like swiss cheese. Milo accidentally plants himself instead of the flowers and gets covered in dirt. Pip tries to water him like a plant. Will Milo grow into a flower tree? Watch till the end!

title: Milo Carries Groceries Tower
story: Milo tries to carry all the grocery bags inside in one trip to be a hero. He stacks bags on his head, on his arms, and even on his tail. Pip balances on top holding the eggs. They wobble through the front door and the stairs. One bag rips and apples roll everywhere. Can they get the eggs to the kitchen without breaking them? Comment below!

title: Milo Paints The House Rainbow
story: Milo decides to paint the house to make it pretty and picks every color of the rainbow. Pip brings the paint buckets but spills blue paint on Milo. Soon Milo is covered in red, yellow, green and blue spots. They chase each other with paint rollers and the whole house becomes a rainbow mess. It actually looks amazing. Did they invent a new art style?

title: Milo Walks Pip To School
story: Milo tries to walk Pip to school on time but they are running super late. Milo runs with Pip in his backpack bouncing up and down. They take a shortcut through the park but get chased by ducks and sprinklers. Pip's little red cap flies off and Milo has to catch it mid-air. Will they make it to school before the bell rings? Follow for the next adventure!

title: Milo Fixes Leaky Faucet Flood
story: The bathroom faucet starts leaking and Milo wants to fix it like a pro plumber. He grabs a wrench but turns the wrong pipe and water shoots to the ceiling like a fountain. Pip tries to stop it with tape but gets launched across the bathroom. The bathroom becomes a swimming pool with rubber ducks floating. How will they stop the flood? Watch till the end!

title: Milo Bakes Cookies Fire Alarm
story: Milo and Pip try to bake chocolate chip cookies for the first time. They mix way too much dough and it grows huge in the oven like a monster. Smoke comes out and the fire alarm starts beeping loudly. Milo waves a towel and Pip opens all the windows. The cookies are burnt but they smell amazing. Are burnt cookies the new trend? Comment your recipe!

title: Milo Does Laundry Again Tornado
story: Milo tries laundry again but puts too many clothes in the washing machine. The machine starts shaking and spinning like a tornado and bubbles fly everywhere. Pip gets sucked into a t-shirt and spins around. Clothes fly out and land on Milo's head like hats. The laundry room is now a clothing tornado. Will they survive the spin cycle? This is part two of the laundry saga!
